test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Those unfamiliar with the saga are bound to be mystified by the more _______ plot twists.
solution:
The correct answer is "**arcane**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Arcane" means mysterious or obscure,(रहस्य का) which fits the context of the sentence.**
 
• This option is the most appropriate because it conveys the idea that the plot twists may be difficult to understand for those not familiar with the saga.
 
• The word arcane is an adjective and is pronounced as ar-kein.
 
 
• Example: The ancient manuscript was written in an arcane language that very few people could understand.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Anoint means to smear or rub with oil or an oily substance, typically as part of a religious ceremony.(अभिषेक करना) It is not related to the context of the sentence.
 
• Option 3: Arbitrary means based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system.(मनमाना) It is not related to the context of the sentence.
 
• Option 4: Aesthetic means concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty.(सौंदर्य संबंधी) It is not related to the context of the sentence.
